notes: Every node in the correction spec's ownership tree is selectable and explodable: crystalClampLeft/Right, both leather connectors, both spinner ends, the driverArray with its four rods, the grip and the pommel. There is no guardCore, no driver socket and no grip end collar to expose — those were components of earlier passes and all of them are deleted rather than hidden.

The grip and the pommel are separate selectable nodes and the explode pulls them apart in that order. There is no collar between them; the grip's own tang carries the guard end of the stack, so the two jaws explode off the leather they were closed on.
